items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think you showed us that picture last week when we were here with the man from Germany.

ctx.x: That's all. Now, Dune, as I believe I've explained it to you once before, during the Spanish and American War, I had 15 pieces that really could play bugle and piccolo and drums. Where's my picture? You got it there?
I think you showed us that picture last week when we were here with the man from Germany.
That's right, yeah. Now, when they were getting ready to go across, Armistice again, stopped us from going. They had a beautiful band. Bugle, piccoloos, and drums.
